about.title: Larry Lo | InnovateXP Limited | Hong Kong
about.intro: I'm Larry, founder of InnovateXP. My positioning is clear: an AI consultant with enterprise architecture vision, organisational rule fluency, and strong human warmth and community connection.
body: I spent 14 years in large enterprises and international organisations, learning how KPIs and systems really work. I know how large institutions operate, and I understand how traditional processes drain a person's passion. This experience makes me understand what consultants miss: the real pain isn't missing technology — it's not knowing how to combine AI with human communication, process, and warmth.

After a major life and career rebuild, I chose to redefine myself. While the world debates how AI will replace people, I know this: technology will keep changing, but genuine human warmth and community connection cannot be replaced by algorithms.

So I don't just teach you tools. I bring system design and development experience, use AI agents to find solutions, and walk with you from 0 to 1. AI handles efficiency. I preserve the human warmth and organisational connection. First we find how to survive, then we build your unique edge.

items.question: What is a Business Workflow Diagnosis — and how is it different?
items.answer: About 30 minutes to lock one revenue- or ops-critical workflow, clarify leaks, ownership, and next steps. Unlike report-only consultants, we can land and co-run so the team actually uses it.

items.question: How much time do I need — and what should I prepare?
items.answer: About 30 minutes. Bring your messiest line (e.g. WhatsApp sign-ups or quotes) and a concrete pain example. No polished deck required.

items.question: How are consulting fees calculated?
items.answer: By workflow complexity and scope — quoted after diagnosis. We don't push a system at the start.

items.question: What if we don't actually need AI or a CRM?
items.answer: I'll say so. Often the issue is unclear ownership and follow-up rhythm, not missing tools. Fixing the process may be enough.

items.question: Will our data and processes stay confidential?
items.answer: Yes. Operational details, customer data, and internal workflows shared in diagnosis or delivery are only used to serve you — never disclosed or published as a case without written consent.

finalCta.body: Bring your messiest workflow. After the session we'll say what to land, what to co-run — or that you shouldn't buy a system yet.

page.whatBody: This is a technology prototype / AI visual-tracking demonstration. It is not a medical diagnostic tool, not a registered medical device, and not a substitute for professional optometry or ophthalmology examination. VisionXP is a bilingual (Cantonese / English) training-workflow demo for paediatric strabismus and amblyopia. Children aged 3–12 complete gamified daily sessions of about 15–20 minutes with rest reminders. Parents see progress, streaks, and achievements. Optometrists see an anonymised patient list, prescriptions, compliance, and reports. The public site at visionquest-web.vercel.app is frontend-only: no login and no patient data stored.
